name: Yomi Hellsmile
original_name: ヨミー・ヘルスマイル
source:
The director of the Amaterasu Corporation Peacekeepers.

Despite having the face of a handsome young man, he is ruthless, finding joy in the misfortune of others, tearing people down, and even treating his underlings like expendable tools. He rules Kanai Ward with force and has established power within Amaterasu with his achievements.

[From [url=https://www.spike-chunsoft.co.jp/pages/raincode/en/character/index2.html]official website[/url]]
